transcript:
Speaker A: Yaar s*** is barish ko aaj hi hona tha aur abhi hona tha. Bhai ek chhatri dena jaldi jaldi. [Man, this rain had to happen today and right now. Brother, give me an umbrella quickly.]
Speaker B: Certainly sir. This one's highly durable and perfectly suited for unexpected weather conditions.
Speaker A: Tu umbrella bech raha hai ya weather conference attend karke aa raha hai? [Are you selling umbrellas or coming from attending a weather conference?]
Speaker B: I'm just selling umbrellas, sir.
Speaker A: Itni fluent English kahan se seekhi? [Where did you learn such fluent English?]
Speaker B: Sirf saat rupaye mein. [For just seven rupees.]
Speaker A: Sirf saat rupaye? [Just seven rupees?]
Speaker B: Haan ji haan, PW Talk se. Roz thodi der Riva AI ke saath English ki practice karta hoon. Real conversations, fluency practice, role plays, sab milta hai. Customer dealing ho, interview ho ya daily communication, automatically improve ho jata hai. [Yes, from PW Talk. I practice English with Riva AI for a little while every day. Real conversations, fluency practice, role plays, you get everything. Whether it's customer dealing, interviews, or daily communication, it automatically improves.]
Speaker A: Matlab English bolne ke liye kisi mehnge course ki zaroorat nahi hai? [Meaning there's no need for an expensive course to speak English?]
Speaker B: Bilkul nahi, PW Talk download karo aur Riva AI ke saath practice shuru karo. [Not at all, download PW Talk and start practicing with Riva AI.]
Speaker A: Sirf saat rupaye mein confidence upgrade, ye deal miss mat karna. [Confidence upgrade for just seven rupees, don't miss this deal.]
Speaker C: English speaking seekhna hai to PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]
